# Annetta

> Annetta is a software developer and IT student based in Jakarta, Indonesia. She creates useful products, playful web experiments, and human-centered digital experiences, working across interfaces, backend systems, and infrastructure.

Annetta's portfolio is an interactive, pool-themed single-page website. It combines storytelling, motion, 3D visuals, project showcases, and accessible HTML content to introduce her work and interests.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://annetta.dev/): The complete interactive portfolio.
- [About](https://annetta.dev/#about): Background, interests, and approach to design and engineering.
- [Projects](https://annetta.dev/#projects): Selected web products and experiments.
- [Skills](https://annetta.dev/#skills): Frontend, backend, infrastructure/DevOps, design, product management, and AI.
- [Contact](https://annetta.dev/#contact): Invitation to discuss projects, unusual ideas, or collaborations.

## Selected projects

- [Poster Buron Generator](https://posterburon.annetta.dev): Turns a photo into a shareable poster buron for posting on Threads. Created and developed by Annetta using web and image tools.
- [One Piece Bounty Poster Generator](https://posteronepiece.annetta.dev): Creates a custom One Piece-style bounty poster directly in the browser using web and Canvas technologies.
- [One Call Away](https://onecallaway.annetta.dev): A gentle reminder product for keeping up with people you care about.
- [Cozy Pomodoro](https://pomodoro.annetta.dev): A calm focus timer with an animated animal companion.
- [Chord Analyzer](https://chord.annetta.dev): A concept for following synchronized chord diagrams while an MP3 or YouTube video plays.
